title: Focus on Zoning Policy and Workforce Diversity
summary:
*   A new policy regarding the postponement of zoning decisions was presented and discussed.
*   Workforce diversity within the Water and Wastewater departments was a key discussion point, accompanied by a detailed presentation.
*   Council members reviewed and discussed proposed agenda items for the upcoming October 31st meeting.
